findings.highlight: I have to get her to go home
findings.evidenceJa: 帰さないと危なっかしくてしょうがない
findings.governingReading: I have to send her home soon; otherwise I cannot stop worrying about her safety
findings.explanation: Shirou’s anxious protectiveness toward Rin disappears, leaving only the practical need to make her leave.

findings.evidenceJa: しまった、と舌打ちする
findings.governingReading: She clicks her tongue at her mistake
findings.explanation: Rin’s irritated tongue-click becomes a different gesture suggesting anxiety or restraint.

findings.highlight: surprise attacks coming from unexpected places
findings.explanation: A figurative failure to anticipate Shirou’s verbal trap becomes an attack arriving from a spatially unexpected location.

findings.governingReading: without a formal procedure or even an abbreviated one
findings.explanation: A technical abbreviated ritual or method becomes the abstract act of making something simpler.

findings.highlight: I won’t be able to do it again
findings.governingReading: I probably cannot do it again
findings.explanation: Shirou’s uncertainty about reproducing the feat becomes categorical inability.

findings.highlight: you should be able to do it anytime
findings.explanation: Rin’s command to turn any achieved result into a learned skill becomes an unsupported claim of immediate anytime repeatability.
Failure to reproduce particular workings becomes inability to use magic at all, while magecraft is again generalized to magic.

findings.highlight: getting all the required materials from within you
findings.evidenceJa: 材料を全部内界から出してきてる
findings.governingReading: drawing every required material from your inner world
findings.explanation: The technical contrast between external world and inner world is reduced to bodily location, encouraging the very misunderstanding Shirou makes on the next page.

findings.highlight: there shouldn’t be any magic that’s impossible for you
findings.evidenceJa: アンタが生きてる限り
findings.governingReading: for as long as you remain alive
findings.explanation: The explicit duration and existential condition on Rin’s repeatability claim disappear.
